lhs: Strict binary32 nearest-even left fold of scalar add from +0 over concatenation A++B.
rhs: Independently fold A and B from +0 and add their scalar results in binary32.
types: Two static F32[2] tensors, scalar F32 output. Nonnegative exact integer inputs ≤ 2^24.
conditions: Axis zero concatenated and reduced; equal block shapes, single output, layout-insensitive. Fixed strict order with binary32 RNE per add. Pinned evaluator slow reduction path; default fast double accumulator and backend reassociation excluded.
overlap: Historical exact AddMonoid.concat-style identity; established r32 arithmetic reused. Counterexample concerns sequential value preservation under the stated grouping. Documented backend reassociation permitted.
